339-677-6965-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-6965-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4210-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4279-4314-5931--216.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-5931--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-3897.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3585-3897.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2843-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-955-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-955-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1594-2146-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

4149-4599-4871-6019-6791.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1753-4149-4599-4871-6019.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating six 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing a Zombie token and Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When the Zombie and Ghoulcaller Gisa die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve Scourge of Nel Toth.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping Scourge of Nel Toth and four other Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller GIsa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

11-469.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
11-469.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with valid targets as applicable.
11-469.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, copying Insidious Will targeting the spell cast in step 1 and returning the original Insidious Will to your hand.
Cast Insidious Will by paying its mana cost, copying the copy of Insidious Will, targeting the copy of Insidious Will.
Resolve the copy of Insidious Will, creating a copy of Insidious Will targeting the copy of Insidious Will.
Repeat step 5.

1946-7070-7444.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

560-2034-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-2034-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

206-1233-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-1233-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-1703-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

129-2113-3995.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-2113-3995.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

465-997-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3671-5184.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-2999-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2999-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3372-5231-6006-6968.description:

Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

1482-2854-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:

Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4476-5641-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4476-5641-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3055-3967-6553.easyPrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
3055-3967-6553.description:

When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

486-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
486-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

643-3951-3967-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-3967-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1651-2561-4094-4559.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1651-2561-4094-4559.description:

Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating two Food tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Foods, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Foods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-3755-5467.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Wylie Duke.
3525-3755-5467.notablePrerequisites: Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3755-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

1980-3368.notablePrerequisites: If desired, you have another instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
1980-3368.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting the spell.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Reiterate, targeting the original Reiterate.
Resolve the copy of Reiterate, copying Reiterate targeting the original Reiterate.
Repeat step 4.

678-2292-2929.notablePrerequisites:
You have an enchantment creature card in hand.
You control at least six enchantments.
You have enough mana to cast the enchantment creature.
678-2292-2929.description:
Cast the enchantment creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Composer of Spring triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the enchantment creature.
When the enchantment creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the enchantment creature to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger from step 2, putting the enchantment creature onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1329-1636-4487.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2744-3192-4050.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2744-3192-4050.description:

The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

709-1887-2232-4852-4977.description:
Cast Tyvar by paying {2}{G}{G}, which enters with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Tyvar's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Tyvar dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Tyvar ability, causing you to get an emblem.
Cast Elvish Mystic by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Elvish Mystic spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Elvish Mystic enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Fyndhorn Elves from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Elvish Mystic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Fyndhorn Elves by paying {G}.
Tyvar's emblem triggers, causing the Fyndhorn Elves spell to gain haste, and you to draw two cards.
Fyndhorn Elves enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Elvish Mystic from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Fyndhorn Elves by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 5.
